name: tpch-conventions
description: Governance bundle for the tpch-snowflake-dbt project: the add-staging-model skill (gated staging workflow), the dbt-reviewer subagent (read-only review by construction), and the guardrails PreToolUse hook (prod/snapshot/DDL/warehouse enforcement). Installing this plugin gives any team member's agent the same conventions, the same runbooks, and the same hard limits.
